build_TextEmbedding: build a TextEmbedding module with a specified embedding type like bilstm or attention for text encoding
create_BiLSTMTextEmbedding: create a BiLSTMTextEmbedding with configurable hidden dim, num layers, and GRU or LSTM rnn type
review_BertVisioLinguisticEmbeddings: review the BertVisioLinguisticEmbeddings class that encodes both text and visual embeddings with BERT token and position embeddings
test_SAEmbedding: test the SAEmbedding MCAN encoder block with self-attention layers and optional attention pooling on text sequences
build_TwoBranchEmbedding: build a TwoBranchEmbedding that combines SGA decoder and CBN bottleneck layers for visual question answering
